gen.title: Practice saving rules and emergency funds

cards.stem: How much should be saved for emergencies as a basic goal?
options: three months’ worth of living expenses
cards.quote: have at least three months’ worth of living expenses saved up in case of an emergency
cards.hint: Consider the basic emergency cushion mentioned.

cards.stem: What workplace benefit can help retirement savings grow faster?
cards.quote: Some employers provide matching contributions as an incentive to save, so it’s smart to save at least enough for the maximum matching contribution.
cards.hint: Look for employer help with retirement accounts.

cards.stem: What does compound interest mean for saved money?
options: earns interest on both the money they save and the interest they earn
cards.quote: Compound interest is when your child earns interest on both the money they save and the interest they earn.
